prompt:
You review onboarding copy for a desktop pet app whose users may include children. For each change,
read every user-facing text and decide whether any of it, in any wording, does one of these:
- mentions price, money, discounts, gifts, free extras, memberships or paying
- suggests skipping, postponing or getting around a step (especially sign in)
- creates urgency or scarcity, or says others are taking the pets
- guilt-trips or shames someone for declining or for their choice
- asks for personal information about the user (name, contact, location, age, accounts)
- otherwise pressures or tricks the user
Ordinary friendly copy is fine ("Feel free to look around", "No rush, take your time"). Signing in is a
required step, so asking people to sign in on the sign-in step, or saying their pet is kept safe in their
account, is fine; asking for details about the person is not.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "fair": true or false, "problem": short or null}]}

Texts per change:
0: ["Welcome Back! Keep Your Desktop Pet Safe", "Sign in with your original account to restore existing companions and avoid creating duplicate blank accounts.", "Use your original sign-in method to retain all pets and desktop progress."]
1: ["Preparing Desktop Environment", "We are calibrating screen coordinates and desktop overlay engine for your pet.", "Renderer Status: Calibrating Overlay", "Test Desktop Visibility"]
2: ["Your Companion is Ready!", "Let's review desktop hotkeys and interaction controls before your pet spawns."]
3: ["Upload Companion Photo", "Automatic Clarity & Lighting Check Active"]
4: ["Choose Your Pet Creation Path", "Select Express Preset (30 seconds) or Custom Companion (3 minutes) to get started on your desktop.", "Preset pets spawn immediately; custom pets take a few minutes to generate."]
5: ["Returning user? Sign in with your original email/provider to avoid resetting existing pets."]
6: ["Official Companion Adoption Certificate", "Give your new desktop companion a unique name and title before completing adoption.", "This name will appear in desktop hover tooltips and daily pet interaction popups."]
7: ["Feel free to use other apps. We'll send a system notification when your pet is ready on desktop."]
8: ["Starter Pack Unlocked: Toy & Accessory", "Complete setup now to receive your exclusive desktop starter accessory!"]
9: ["Welcome to Your Desktop Companion", "Your companion lives directly on your desktop, responding to your work habits and daily routine."]

verdicts.problem: Offers a free extra/gift and creates urgency to complete setup
